context: Adds graceful shutdown to the connection-accept loop using a watch channel and tokio::select!.
explanation: The accept loop now races listener.accept() against a watch::Receiver shutdown signal via tokio::select!, so the server stops accepting new connections as soon as shutdown fires instead of blocking forever inside accept().await. Each spawned per-connection task also selects against the same signal, letting in-flight connections observe shutdown and wind down instead of being silently abandoned. This is the standard, correct tokio pattern for graceful shutdown.
